The reported chemical input is about 3.099733884 and output/fuel ratio 0.00024075; actuator hardware cost is excluded. A separate 4096-interval output is retained as a separate version. The atomic-return test assumes finite irreducible CTMC source-clock dynamics, a fixed repeated closed protocol, exact full-state A herald at the same period boundary/phase, and exact work or a valid one-sided work bound; its optional stopping guarantee is across actual atomic returns, not blocks or arbitrary within-excursion times. The broad source-clock closed-state-cycle passivity claim is asserted, but its full Gibbs-tilt derivation was not located; the fixed-stationary-start fixed-horizon IFT does not supply it.
